proposed_widenings.name: RollKind.spell_attack_roll
proposed_widenings.justification: The current roll vocabulary only has the broad attack_roll bucket. Using that here would incorrectly cover weapon attacks and double-count the staff's own quarterstaff bonus. The passive rider needs spell-attack-only narrowing.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls."

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form transforms the staff itself into a planted tree and later reverts that transformed object. The current attachment grammar has no honest item/object attachment target for this mode.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "...plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree. While touching the tree and using a Magic action, you return the staff to its normal form."

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.fall_on_end
proposed_widenings.justification: Reverting the tree to staff form makes creatures in the tree fall. The v4 taxonomy already names this effect, but the current surface does not expose it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff."

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.last_charge_becomes_nonmagical
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing last-charge lifecycle only models destruction. This item instead survives as a mundane Quarterstaff after the failure roll.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff."

notes: Authored and traced the encodable subset: attunement by druid, passive +2 quarterstaff attack/damage bonuses, 6-charge spell table, dawn recharge, and the existing last-charge roll lifecycle. Omitted as unsupported surface gaps: the +2 spell attack roll rider, Tree Form and its revert interaction, and the nonmagical-quarterstaff failure mode.
